preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two integers n and k separated by whitespace
n is in [1, 3e5] and k is in [0, 1e18]

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout) == 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]) and all(c in '()' for c in stdout) and is_regular_bracket_sequence(stdout) and total_nesting_sum(stdout) == int(stdin.split()[1]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, stdout is a regular bracket sequence of length 2n with total nesting sum exactly k; otherwise, stdout is 'Impossible'
